LanguageData.Gun_SKS-45_RWP.description: The SKS-45 is a reliable semi-automatic rifle known for its durability and simplicity. Originally designed for military use, it offers moderate stopping power and accuracy, making it a versatile choice for mid-range combat. The integrated bayonet adds a secondary melee option, enhancing its utility in close-quarters skirmishes.
